tasks.corrected_reference_answer: The pinned navigation generator creates top-level pages or headers with direct page children and rejects configuration entries beyond its supported tuple lengths (mkdocs/nav.py:197-241). walk_pages follows next_page once per page and updates active/context state (44-64). Deep hierarchy support is a structural limitation here; the source does not demonstrate quadratic traversal or measured rendering failure.

tasks.notes: Read the question/reference and relevant pinned-source code; static review only, no repository code executed.
tasks.corrected_reference_answer: setup.py selects Markdown>=2.3.1,<2.5 on Python 2.6 and >=2.3.1 otherwise (setup.py:10-23). requirements.txt requires Markdown>=2.5, and tox includes that file for its test environments, including py26 (tox.ini:2-12). These constraints conflict for Python 2.6; the repository does not show a rule making setup.py automatically override or ignore requirements.txt. They should not be described as a reliably coordinated dual-constraint solution.
